title: Corsicans / Network Assessment
summary: Restricted assessment of a network referred to in surviving records as the Corsicans. Structure, membership and territorial extent remain uncertain.
body:
SUBJECT

CORSICANS

The Corsicans are referenced as a distributed network rather than a clearly bounded organisation.

Sources variously describe them as brokers, smugglers, contractors and intermediaries. Membership lists are inconsistent and may represent overlapping networks rather than a single group.

No reliable estimate of size or territorial reach is available.

ARCHIVE NOTE

The name may be exonymic. Source material does not establish what members call the organisation themselves.
